description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: Used to ensure the idempotency of the request. This parameter value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests, with a maximum length of 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
服务关联角色名称。可选值：

<props="china">- AliyunServiceRoleForElasticsearchOps：执行集群弹性扩缩容任务</props>- AliyunServiceRoleForElasticsearchCollector：创建和管理Beats采集器
description.en:
The service-linked role name. Valid values:

<props="china">- AliyunServiceRoleForElasticsearchOps: Performs elastic scaling tasks for a cluster.</props>- AliyunServiceRoleForElasticsearchCollector: Creates and manages Beats collectors.

descriptions.zh: > 在通过采集器采集来自不同数据源的日志时，需要先授权创建服务关联角色。您可以调用此接口，验证是否已经创建。
descriptions.en: > When you use a collector to collect logs from different data sources, you must first authorize the creation of a service-linked role. You can call this operation to check whether the service-linked role has been created.
